From 58f9f135630fb4f5557f36c0b2d87e50f3afcf08 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: jeanlf <jeanlf@github.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2020 14:38:10 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] fixed bug introduced by cdc5d3a3


diff --git a/src/filter_core/filter.c b/src/filter_core/filter.c
index d765c1d02..93e9672d3 100644
--- a/src/filter_core/filter.c
+++ b/src/filter_core/filter.c
@@ -1810,7 +1810,9 @@ static void gf_filter_renegociate_output(GF_Filter *filter, Bool force_afchain_i
 
 void gf_filter_renegociate_output_task(GF_FSTask *task)
 {
-	gf_filter_renegociate_output(task->filter, GF_TRUE);
+	//it is possible that the cap renegociation was already done at the time we process this task
+	if (task->filter->nb_caps_renegociate)
+		gf_filter_renegociate_output(task->filter, GF_TRUE);
 }
 
 static void gf_filter_check_pending_tasks(GF_Filter *filter, GF_FSTask *task)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `src/filter_core/filter.c`**
   - A conditional check was added in the function `gf_filter_renegociate_output_task`. 
   - The line that calls `gf_filter_renegociate_output(task->filter, GF_TRUE);` was modified to first check if `task->filter->nb_caps_renegociate` is non-zero. If this condition is true, the function `gf_filter_renegociate_output` is called; otherwise, it is skipped.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `src/filter_core/filter.c` addresses a bug that was likely introduced in a previous commit (referenced as `cdc5d3a3`). The added conditional check prevents unnecessary calls to `gf_filter_renegociate_output` when the capabilities renegotiation has already been performed, thus ensuring that the function is only executed when needed. This change improves the efficiency of the task processing and avoids potential issues related to redundant renegotiation.
